scenes.name: COORDINATE AREAS
lines: Start in three dimensions. Two vectors span a parallelogram; each coordinate pair records a projected area.
先看三维。两个向量张成平行四边形，每对坐标记录一个投影面积。
Here the squared areas are nine twenty-fifths and sixteen twenty-fifths. The third is zero. Their total is one.
这里的面积平方为二十五分之九与二十五分之十六，第三个为零，总和是一。
Prices two, five and one give a weighted total of ninety-eight twenty-fifths, between one and five.
价格取二、五、一，加权总和为二十五分之九十八，位于一与五之间。

scenes.name: THE ORIGINAL COMPARISON
lines: For a real orthonormal triple in any dimension, every symmetric matrix with strictly positive entries satisfies this upper comparison.
在任意维数中，实数正交单位三元组和所有元素严格为正的对称矩阵满足这个上界。
Each volume square receives the largest of its three edge prices. This precise statement has a Lean theorem.
每个体积平方采用其三条边中最大的价格。这个准确陈述有对应的 Lean 定理。

scenes.name: LIFT AND CONTRACT
lines: The written argument needs only a unit vector z perpendicular to x and y. They need not be unit or mutually perpendicular.
书面论证只要求单位向量 z 垂直于 x 和 y；后两者不必归一化或互相垂直。
Adjoining z preserves total squared mass. Contraction recovers the area data without increasing length.
添上 z 保持平方总质量；收缩恢复面积数据而不增长度。
Recovering one edge reads only volumes whose triples contain that edge.
恢复一条边，只读取包含这条边的三元组体积。

scenes.name: LOCALITY CONTROLS FAMILIES
lines: Choose any family of edges. Keep every triangle containing a chosen edge, counting each triangle once.
任取一组边，保留所有包含所选边的三角形，每个三角形只计一次。
Discard the other volume coordinates, contract, then keep the selected area coordinates. Neither operation increases length.
丢掉其余体积坐标，收缩，再保留所选面积坐标；这些操作都不增长度。
So the selected squared areas cannot exceed the retained squared volumes.
因此所选面积平方总和不超过保留的体积平方总和。

scenes.name: PRICES AS FINITE LAYERS
lines: For nonnegative prices, build one, three and four from layers of thickness one, two and one.
对非负价格，用厚度一、二、一的层构成价格一、三、四。
At each level, a triangle survives exactly when at least one edge reaches that level: its maximum price does.
每层中，三角形被保留恰好等价于至少一条边达到该层，也就是最大价格达到该层。
Add the family comparisons, weighted by layer thickness, to recover the upper bound.
按层厚度加总坐标族比较，就恢复了加权上界。

scenes.name: EQUAL MASS CANCELS
lines: Under the same real unit-z and perpendicularity assumptions, negative prices work too. Subtract the smallest price to make all prices nonnegative.
在同一实数、单位 z 和垂直假设下，负价格也成立。减去最小价格，使全部价格非负。
Both totals change by the same constant times their common mass. That term cancels.
两边总价都改变同一个常数乘以共同质量，该项恰好消去。
Negate all prices to turn the maximum upper bound into the minimum lower bound.
把全部价格取负，就把最大值上界变成最小值下界。

scenes.name: THE IDEA AND ITS SOURCES
lines: The question is meler’s. Lyons’s earlier theorem implies the orthonormal comparison; Miller and Bistron gave a direct two-sided proof.
问题来自 meler。Lyons 的早期定理已蕴含正交单位比较；Miller 与 Bistroń 给出过直接双侧证明。
Haobo Ma and Wenlin Zhang explain the contraction argument and its extensions. The key is locality, then layers, then equal-mass cancellation.
Haobo Ma 与 Wenlin Zhang 解释收缩论证及其推广。关键是局部性、分层和等质量消去。
